sources.prompt:
Use the attached images only as style references: match the painterly look, fine grain, cold stone masonry, half-timbering, night palette and warm amber lantern light of the harbour scene (first image), of our harbour facades (second image) and of our back-street houses (third image). Do not copy their composition.

Paint ONE isolated background layer for a 2.5D night harbour town, seen straight from the front like an architectural elevation (camera at eye level, no perspective tilt, no vanishing lines): a continuous row of six tall, narrow townhouses of the seers' quarter lining a canal, spanning the full width of the image, four storeys tall plus their roofs, filling about the lower 85% of the image. Scale: a person is about 100 pixels tall in this image; doors are about 130 pixels tall. Each house is narrow and tall, its half-timbered upper storeys jettied out over the street, steep slate roofs with pointed gables and thin chimneys, heights varying by about one storey; clear vertical party walls between the houses. Street level, from left to right: a narrow door with a hanging lantern, a seer's little shop with a veil-blue awning and a window full of candles and crystal globes, a closed shutter shop, the tallest house with a carved door and two long veil-blue and silver cloth banners (plain), a bow window glowing warm amber, a plain door with a pale silver-blue lamp. Upper storeys: warm lit windows and dark ones, one small balcony, laundry on a pole. Light mixes warm amber lanterns with a few cold silver-blue lamps.

The bottom edge of the image is a straight horizontal line at the foot of the walls, with no ground, no steps and no cobbles in front.

Everything around the subjects (above the roofs, between the panels, around the objects) is a perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shading, no texture, no sky, no clouds, no moon, no distant city.

Strictly no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no logos, no playing-card suit symbols, no emblems on any cloth.

Style bible: stylized HD-2D, theatrical; night with near-monochrome indigo and slate dominant, cold grey stone as secondary, warm amber lantern light, desaturated ivory for canvas and highlights; the four family colours (ember orange, veil blue and silver, bramble green, star gold) only on banners and small accents; props concentrated at focal points, never uniform clutter; world of a harbour city where people challenge each other at card duels.

etapes: emblèmes des familles du jeu brodés en relief sur 2 bannière(s) unie(s) (fixBanners, tracés de src/art/emblems.ts), sur le brut, avant tout traitement
fond magenta détouré (alpha tiré de l’écart au magenta, bords démêlés du fond), recadré sur le pied des murs
